Rotation.RotationNotes:
Pure BG Arms (reworked). No boss gates.
REAL KICK: A:Pummel (Kick) — dances Berserker Stance and casts Pummel (6552). Heroic Throw does NOT interrupt (old Interrupt Engine:A removed from this list).
OPENER: Charge (out of combat) → Intercept (in combat gap, 25 rage).
PRIORITY: markers/shouts/stone/potion → Berserker Rage (CC break, dances zerk) → **Pummel** → Spell Reflect vs casters/panic → Disarm vs melee → **Battle Stance** (restores default; skipped while kick window) → Enraged Regen (if talented, HP≤30) → trinkets → racials → Shattering Throw (BoP/IB) → Charge/Intercept → Bladestorm (hold Shift) → Death Wish/Reck (IsSpellKnown + only when target≤60 / you pressured) → Sweeping Strikes (real CD) → Bloodrage → **Rend → Mortal Strike → Overpower → Execute** → Hamstring/Piercing Howl (once each) → Demo Shout → Thunder Clap → Heroic Strike only ≥45 rage (Cleave if AoE mode).
HOTKEYS: Left Ctrl = pause. Left Shift = Bladestorm. AoE toggle lives on Fury `-- Hotkeys --` only.
TALENTS assumed (adjust): 21/5/5 Arms PvP. Death Wish / Reck / Enraged Regen / Piercing Howl no-op if not known (IsSpellKnown gate).
TEST: /run PQR_TestMode = true. Disable: /run PQR_TestMode = nil. Carry healthstone + healing potions.
